title: Top 7 Featured DEV Posts of the Week
why_read: A roundup of community blog posts with mixed and mostly lightweight technical substance.
analysis: This is Dev.to's weekly curated list of popular posts, covering topics like what skills to teach kids in an AI era, a personal game-dev story using AI coding tools, and a creative geometry visualization of the Fibonacci spiral using three.js. None of these are deeply technical deep-dives; they are personal reflections and lightweight demos rather than rigorous engineering content. The Fibonacci spiral/three.js piece has the most concrete technical content among the three highlighted. Overall this is a low-density digest of casual blog content rather than something engineers need to read.
